subject.title: macOS launchd Gateway still restarts via gateway-update/update.run; document and honor auto-update kill-switch

question: Should `OPENCLAW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1` also block explicit Gateway control-plane `update.run` managed-service restarts for supervised launchd/headless deployments?
rationale: Current code and docs scope the variable to configured background auto-update applies, while the reported operator need is a broader supervised Gateway restart kill-switch that changes explicit `update.run` semantics.

options.title: Extend existing kill-switch
options.body: Make `OPENCLAW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1` block supervised `update.run` managed-service handoffs before any handoff or restart metadata is written, and update docs/tests to define that broader operator contract.

options.title: Keep current split
options.body: Leave explicit `update.run` outside the auto-update kill-switch and update docs to state that operators must disable or avoid the UI/control-plane update path separately.

options.title: Add a separate explicit-update gate
options.body: Introduce a differently named, documented operator control for control-plane update restarts without changing the existing background auto-update variable.

recommendation.title: Extend existing kill-switch
recommendation.body: Make `OPENCLAW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1` block supervised `update.run` managed-service handoffs before any handoff or restart metadata is written, and update docs/tests to define that broader operator contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the existing kill-switch and have recent review context on the related macOS update-run contract.
